h1: A fresh BigCommerce redesign that keeps your rankings
overview: We redesign how your BigCommerce store looks and feels without moving your products or changing your page addresses. We start with a short review of your current store, agree a direction with you, then rebuild the home page, category pages and product pages in a Stencil theme copy. You approve a preview before anything goes live, so your catalog and links stay exactly where search engines expect them.

faq: No. A redesign changes how pages look, not their addresses. We keep your product, category and page links the same, and check titles and descriptions before and after launch.
Do I need to supply a design?
No. We propose a direction based on your brand and examples you like. If you already have a design file, send it and we follow it closely.
Do I keep my current theme?
We build the redesign on a copy of your theme, or on a fresh Stencil theme if yours is too old to extend. You see a preview before it replaces anything.
Can you also move me to a new platform?
That is a separate migration service. This one is for stores staying on BigCommerce, so your catalog and settings are not disturbed.
